segments.name: Solar
segments.description: Manufactures and supplies solar cells and solar PV modules to affiliate VSUN, a select group of module manufacturers and U.S. module customers.
segments.evidence: Since the Company operates in one reportable segment, all financial information required can be found in the consolidated financial statements.

revenueModel.text: Customers including affiliate VSUN and a select group of PV module manufacturers pay the company for its solar cells and solar PV modules.
revenueModel.evidence: We plan to supply our solar PV modules, initially in collaboration with VSUN, leveraging its experience and certification.
